facts.raw_span: A 45-year-old man presented with recent-onset dry cough and exertional dyspnea
no significant past medical history
Initial contrast-enhanced CT of the chest revealed a 12 cm mass in the anterior superior mediastinum
multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules suggestive of metastatic disease
neck edema, distended neck veins, and facial plethora
invasion of the superior vena cava above the azygos vein and thrombus extending into the left brachiocephalic trunk
rapid symptomatic relief
Histopathology showed a multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells with clear cytoplasm
Immunohistochemistry demonstrated diffuse strong WT1 positivity
moderate, patchy CD99 positivity
